usize.target_fact: A TARGET fact, not an assumption: the recorded producer is trustc on aarch64-apple-darwin, a 64-bit target. On a 32-bit target the flat enum tag would be 32 bits wide and this table would be WRONG, which is why the width is a reviewed pin rather than a constant inside a reader.

Note the body ALSO contains genuine `i64` constants (`const i64 1`, twice), so this chain is exactly the shape where the count matters: a swap in either direction changes it.
